controls.procedure: Execute an explicit brand outside KNOWN_BRANDS while a usable generic reference exists.
controls.expected: Canonical commercial identity precedes generic portion.
controls.observed: Exact-head #6183 passes Seven Boys canonical preflight before generic portion, plus explicit integral variant preservation and generic-composition regression guards.

controls.procedure: Fail commercial search for an unknown explicit brand while generic portion remains available.
controls.expected: Identity remains pending; no generic portion or weight fallback.
controls.observed: Exact-head #6183 preserves brand_variant_unresolved for unavailable unknown-brand resolution and does not fall through to generic portion/measure search.

controls.procedure: Derive certificate scope from git diff --name-only between the immutable work_item_start_sha and the refrozen material head, with no curated path filtering.
controls.expected: The rebuilt scope equals the complete immutable work-item delta and its digest is generated from that exact normalized set.
controls.observed: The refrozen material head has 92 changed paths from the immutable work-item start SHA; builder input is derived from that exact normalized Git compare.

controls.procedure: Detect any material write after a previously published result-only handoff and require a full post-write refreeze before audit release.
controls.expected: A stale certificate cannot certify a later code/test/documentation head; recovery must be post-write-refreeze and the next published child must have the current material head as direct parent.
controls.observed: The stale package was classified post-write-refreeze for code, test and documentation siblings; material candidate acfa6053 is now frozen only after current Agent-first and TiDB gates are green.

rationale: Cumulative independent-audit controls are revalidated on acfa6053. The latest rejection adds a terminal-handoff lifecycle control: any material write after a published result-only child forces post-write-refreeze before a new independent audit.
